svg.metadata: {"story":"Jacob","act":10,"chapter":"Ch.10 · Joseph’s Coats","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Joseph is seventeen and his father loves him; the coat of many colours and the dreams of sheaves and stars set the brothers against him.
